item.title: The Local Fellowship 2026 | The Local
item.description: Our fellowship program provides training and mentorship to emerging journalists from communities underrepresented in Canadian media. Applications are now open.

item.title: The Province Took Over Ontario’s Biggest School Boards to Fix Their Finances. The Numbers Tell a Different Story | The Local
item.description: Analysis by The Local shows Ontario’s largest boards receive some of the lowest per-pupil funding in the province—raising questions about whether the real problem is mismanagement or the funding formula.

item.title: Canada’s Oldest AIDS Organization Closes After Four Decades | The Local
item.description: The AIDS Committee of Toronto was at the centre of this city’s response to a crisis. As it shuts its doors this month, the people who built it reckon with its unfinished legacy.

item.title: We’re Hiring a Peel Reporter | The Local
item.description: The Local is looking for a talented journalist to join our team as a staff reporter covering civic issues in Mississauga and Brampton.
